title: Rebalancing of trade with China 'existential' for EU, Commissioner Séjourné tells Euronews
content: The EU Industry Commissioner warned that the EU will consider using punitive trade measures if Beijing does not rebalance the trade deficit, which costs the bloc thousands of jobs every week.
